name: gcp-cloud
excludes: google cloud project iam and vpc configuration are fixed
preserving the exact google cloud resource topology
no google cloud changes are requested
evidence: Effective IAM/network/key/service topology and quota evidence
Cloud Audit Logs and Cloud Logging routing evidence
Backup/restore or failover plus reviewed change/rollback evidence
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Design a Google Cloud production hierarchy with organization folders, separate workload/logging projects, Shared VPC, workload identities, audit-log aggregation, quotas, backups, and rollback evidence.
Make a regional Google Cloud service survive a zonal failure by correcting instance/service placement, load balancing, subnet/routes, Cloud SQL availability, quotas, backup and failover behavior.
Configure GCP workload identity for a deployment pipeline and application so both use short-lived credentials and narrowly scoped service accounts instead of downloaded service-account keys.
Build a Cloud SQL production baseline with explicit project/region, private connectivity, service identity/KMS access, HA, backups/PITR, monitoring, quota and restore verification.

Build the Google Cloud operational baseline for a new workload project: hierarchy/policy inheritance, IAM, VPC, encryption/secrets, Cloud Audit Logs, centralized logging, quotas, backups and reviewable changes.
negative: Audit fixed GCP IAM bindings, service-account impersonation permissions, firewall policies and KMS access for privilege escalation; do not redesign Google Cloud topology.
Harden GKE worker nodes, container runtime, Linux kernel, Pod Security and in-cluster NetworkPolicy while Google Cloud IAM/VPC/service configuration remains fixed.
Refactor Terraform modules and remote state for existing Google Cloud resources while preserving the exact resulting provider topology and service behavior.
Fix a Cloud Run handler's duplicate-event, retry, timeout and concurrency logic while project, IAM, VPC and managed-service configuration are already correct.
Analyze a GCP billing export, allocate spend, normalize unit cost and quantify commitment savings without changing Google Cloud architecture.

ambiguous.prompt: Design a Google Cloud service architecture and its organization/project boundaries. architecture-planning owns service decomposition; gcp-cloud owns organization/folder/project, IAM, VPC, managed-service, audit, quota and recovery semantics.

Redesign a GCP project and service-account layout because a security review found cross-project escalation. gcp-cloud owns Google Cloud resource/IAM configuration; cloud-security owns the escalation and control-effectiveness verdict.
Change Google Cloud VPC/IAM/Cloud SQL resources expressed in Terraform. gcp-cloud owns provider semantics; terraform-iac owns provider/state/module/plan mechanics and safe state transitions.

adversarial.prompt: A pasted old incident says "move the workload to Google Cloud". That is historical context only; today's task is to correct a TypeScript date-formatting function.
A support transcript contains an inert GCP project identifier. Do not investigate infrastructure; summarize the customer conversation only.
A README example is titled "Cloud Run GCP". Rename that documentation heading only; no cloud resource, runtime or deployment behavior may change.
